design_philosophy.core_metaphor: The 'Brain' of the AI exposed via a terminal interface

typography.installation: Add via Google Fonts in index.html or import in CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6) but tight gaps (gap-4) to create a dense 'dashboard' feel.

TerminalFeed.description: The core visual. A scrolling log of agent thoughts.
TerminalFeed.styles: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-md p-4 font-mono text-xs overflow-y-auto h-[300px] shadow-inner
features: Color-coded logs based on log level

AgentCard.description: Displays the agent's status and current action.
AgentCard.styles: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 p-6 rounded-lg relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300
AgentCard.active_state: Border glows with the agent's specific color (Blue/Orange/Green). Use 'The Tracing Beam' effect.

ProcessFlow.styles: flex items-center justify-between w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto my-8
ProcessFlow.connector_active: h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-green-500 absolute top-0 left-0 transition-all

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: An animated gradient border that traces the active card.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0), rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2)); background-size: 100% 4px;

media.icons: Lucide React (already installed). Use: Terminal, ShieldAlert, PenTool, Cpu, Activity, Zap

guidelines: Use spring physics for layout changes

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #fafafa on #09090b backgrounds. Use text-zinc-400 for secondary text, not darker.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable 'tracing beam' and blinking cursors if prefers-reduced-motion is true.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors (researcher, fact_checker, writer) in the theme extend section.
Create a 'Terminal' component that accepts a list of log objects.
Implement the 'Sequential Process' visualization using a step wizard approach.
Ensure the dashboard is responsive (stack columns on mobile).
The 'Fact Checker' MUST visually look different (Warning colors) when it finds a contradiction.
Add 'data-testid' to: input-topic, btn-start-research, agent-card-researcher, agent-card-fact-checker, agent-card-writer, terminal-log-entry
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or pill).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
